title: The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, April 27, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, April 27, 2018 Posted by admin on April 27th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -36 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +238.51 (+0.99%) at 24,322.34.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -1.61%.
There were 25 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Visa (V) +4.84% and Home Depot (HD) +4.70%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Disney (DIS) -1.30% and 3M (MMM) -0.88%.
Intel (INTC +3.25%) jumped nearly 8% in after-hours trading after it reported Q1 revenue of $16.1 billion, above consensus of $15.06 billion, and raised guidance on full-year revenue to $67.5 billion + or – $1 billion from a prior estimate of $65 billion + or – $1 billion, better than consensus of $65.1 billion.
Microsoft (MSFT +2.11%) rose 3% in pre-market trading after it was upgraded to ‘Overweight’ from ‘Neutral’ at JPMorgan Chase.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up eight-tenths of a cent at $2.800 per gallon.
